integrity: The integer-lattice statement has an explicit proof and an executable exact-arithmetic finite verification; computation is not the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Applies to complex cyclic quotient plane actions with weights (1,a) and gcd(a,n)=1, n>=3. The Hessian is taken without a factor 1/2. The result does not cover nonunit second weights, other finite groups, Hilbert-scheme existence assertions, or independent validation. General pre-existing circulant techniques could conceivably contain an unindexed equivalent specialization.
title: Integral Euler cokernels of isolated cyclic quotient planes
